The '''2016–17 [[FIS Snowboard World Cup]]''' was 23rd multi race season in [[snowboarding]]. Competition consisted of the parallel slalom, parallel giant slalom, [[snowboard cross]], [[Half-pipe|halfpipe]], slopestyle and big air.

== Men ==
